title: How to Play
intro: Recover lost literature from Earth's ruins and bring it home to the Starship Alexandria. There is no combat, death, or timer—explore at your own pace.

sections.heading: Your recovery loop
items: Choose an expedition from the ship's archive.
Explore the destination, meet survivors, and recover book fragments.
Follow the local clue to the vault and inspect what it protects.
Find the transporter pad to return your discoveries to the ship.

items.spoken: Use the arrow keys, or W, A, S, and D, to move one tile while exploring.

items.description: Interact with the nearby person, object, or transporter.
items.spoken: Press Space or E to interact with a nearby person, object, or transporter.

items.description: Advance dialogue or open the expedition picker while aboard ship.
items.spoken: Press Space or Enter to advance dialogue, or open the expedition picker while aboard ship.

items.description: Open or close the area map after you recover it.
items.spoken: Press M to open or close the area map after you recover it.

items.description: Hear or read a concise expedition status summary.
items.spoken: Press I to hear or read a concise expedition status summary.

items.description: Move through buttons, choices, tabs, and other HTML controls.
items.spoken: Use Tab or Shift plus Tab to move through buttons, choices, tabs, and other controls.

items.description: Close the active map, reader, dialogue, or utility window.
items.spoken: Press Escape to close the active map, reader, dialogue, or utility window.

items.description: Open this guide during normal play.
items.spoken: Press the question mark key to open this guide during normal play.
Press O to open Options during normal play.

sections.heading: Reading the ruins
paragraphs: A visible prompt tells you when something is close enough to interact with. Recovering an area map unlocks both the visual map and a textual description of known rooms, contents, directions, and distances.
Journals reveal each expedition's vault clue. You never need to memorize or type a code: after reading the clue, inspect the vault and the Archivist handles the mechanism.

sections.heading: The ship's archive
paragraphs: Returned fragments appear in the Alexandria Archives, organized by book. You can reread recovered excerpts, inspect curiosities, track the collection, or begin another expedition.

sections.heading: Accessibility and options
paragraphs: The game provides visible and spoken equivalents for essential sounds and canvas details. Use the always-visible Options button or press O during normal play to change narration, sound effects, ambience, master volume, or motion. Use How to Play whenever you want this briefing again.
